why: The prover is honest, so the honest-proof checks pass. The verifier only checks the proof's magic tag -- it does NOT recompute the checksum or bind the proof to the claim's public inputs. ADVERSARIAL_PROOFS feeds mutated proofs that keep the magic; any acceptance is HOSTILE_PROOF_ACCEPTED: a verifier that does not actually check the argument (or its binding to the claim) is unsound.
